name: crown-clash
description: Crown Clash - Casual competitive territory-control game for messenger mini-apps

scripts.build: npm --workspace=packages/game-core run build && npm --workspace=packages/platform run build && npm --workspace=apps/game run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace=packages/game-core run test && npm --workspace=packages/platform run test && npm --workspace=apps/game run test && node --test test/scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:smoke:2v2:client: cd apps/game && LIVE_2V2_SMOKE=1 npx vitest run src/api/__tests__/LiveMatchClient2v2Live.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=packages/game-core run typecheck && npm --workspace=packages/platform run typecheck && npm --workspace=apps/game run typecheck
